summary: KKR FS Income Trust Select filed an 8-K to announce a monthly dividend of $0.175 per share, payable on or about July 29, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026. Shareholders may elect cash or reinvestment in shares under the DRIP. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other extraordinary corporate event is disclosed. The sole item is a standard distribution update. No risk-arb angle arises, as there are no deal terms or structural changes to analyze.
